card.name: Noun ending a drug or plasma phrase
card.fires_on: The last word of a noun phrase right after a drug name or 'plasma', such as concentrations, tablets, capsules, tract, or the final piece of a drug name. It appears in drug-label sentences about interactions and use in patients.
